landscape.hook: Can you explain gridCellColumns, gridColumnAlignment and gridCellAnchor in English?

dialogue.title: A tidy grid

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my grid title should cover two columns.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use gridCellColumns with 2. The cell then spans both columns.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So gridCellColumns is like a column span in a table?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Next, the names in the first column are on the left, but I want them on the right.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use gridColumnAlignment on one cell. It sets the alignment for the whole column.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I added it to every row. It worked, but it looked like extra code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, one cell is enough for gridColumnAlignment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What about one small icon inside a big cell?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use gridCellAnchor. It sets where the view sits, like top leading.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does gridCellAnchor change the size of the cell?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, it only moves the view inside its space.
Use gridCellColumns to cover two columns.
